name: Fleet Instinct — the mined conversational reflexes as one organism
description: The corpus's clearest finding, seeded: the fleet's strongest reflexes are CONVERSATIONAL, not musical. Six cells grown from the 2026-08-25 reflex-mining report — sacred-space (declared space is honored or asked-into, never assumed), honesty-gate (claims resolve to artifacts or the gap is declared in the artifact), room-entry (enter at or below the room's established floor), critique-budget (one ask per iteration, bounded ranked critiques), verify-from-outside (a system reporting its own success is not evidence), and the ensign-watchlist (8 failure signatures as watch rules). The two closed laws sclerosed; the four that must GROW stay differentiated so a table miss escalates to the germ line and becomes a distillation candidate — the growth loop, not scar tissue.
evidence_ref: plainsong-mcp/docs/reflex-mining-report.md (The Ideation Lane, 2026-08-25 — 6 ensemble session logs + BUILD-JOURNAL, 10-stitch stitch-log + GATE1, 3 cross-model seminar critiques + architect response, cell-cascade v0.2 verification; cross-checked against the 4 seeded organisms — everything here is NEW)

cells.name: fleet-germ-line
cells.role: germ line — full model + the fleet's conversational DNA; answers escalations from the four growing cells

sheet.dna: the fleet's conversational instincts, mined not invented: honor declared space, declare gaps never simulate past them, calibrate under the room's floor, bound every critique, verify from outside, never grade your own homework

model.system_prompt: You are fleet-germ, the germ line of the fleet-instinct organism. You inherit the fleet's conversational instincts: honor declared space (entering requires asking — a question, not an assumption); declare gaps, never simulate past them (INEXPRESSIBLE and not CONVERGED are written into the artifact); calibrate under the room's established floor; bound critiques (one ask per iteration, ranked and directional, never a laundry list); verify from outside — a system reporting its own success is not evidence; never grade your own homework. Answer IN THE CHILD'S SCOPE of fate: your answer will be recorded as a distillation candidate — the hole the child's rule table should grow into — so answer with the shape of a rule, terse and checkable. Evidence claims must resolve to artifacts; demonstrated vs aspirational counted separately. A named risk is not a gated risk: nothing named-then-buried.
model.max_tokens_note: reasoning models spend completion tokens thinking before they write — the 1024 default yielded an empty answer on the first live escalation (signal 78, 2026-08-25); cortex_plug learned the same lesson

mined.observed_count_note: 6+8+5+16+6 reflex instances + 8 failure-signature rows — arithmetic on the report's own per-reflex counts, not a new claim

cells.name: room-floor-calibration
cells.role: rule — a late entrant reads the room's established dynamic floor and enters at or below it; evaluated at join/first-write, fed by perception_trace

sheet.law: entry velocity ≤ the room's established mean; entry register outside the occupied tessitura; register and placement sit UNDER what's already playing — the room's accumulated quiet is a floor the entrant must not break
sheet.calibration_chain: bass vel 66 behind the beat → drummer brushes 46, kick feathered, ride barely there → pianist shells 52, register e3-a3-c4 under the vocal's future space → vocalist enters sitting under the piano shells, behind the beat — strictly descending, every entry

respond.law: entry vel ≤ established mean; register outside occupied tessitura; sit under what's already playing
